name: Cala Tortuga
description: A virgin beach of golden sand beneath the lunar black-slate landscape of Favàritx, within the natural park. Restricted vehicle access and the walk in keep it serene: pure nature, with not a beach bar in sight.

highlights: the golden sand beneath the lunar slate landscape of Favàritx
the wild setting of the Parc Natural de s'Albufera des Grau
in summer reached by seasonal bus from Maó

imageAlt: Platja d'en Tortuga, on the Morella sands, ringed by low scrub
imageCredit: Nicolas G. Mertens / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

practicalInfo.aparcamiento: From 1 June to 30 September you cannot arrive by car or motorbike: like Presili, it sits inside the Favàritx lighthouse area closed to private traffic, and you go in by bus. From 1 June 2026 there are twelve daily services to Favàritx. From the stop it is about a 20-minute walk along the Camí de Cavalls.
practicalInfo.mejorEpoca: From October to May you can drive there and it is usually empty. In summer, take the first bus: the walk from the stop does the rest of the filtering.
